description_en: Queries a list of commands pending approval
description_zh: 获取需要审批的命令列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-approve-commands --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zvp2xvysf08 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApproveCommands

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 1000. The default value is 20. If this parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为1000。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the approval request. Valid values:

1: Pending approval.

2: Approved.
If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 1, and only approval requests in the pending approval status are queried
parameters.help_zh:
审批单状态。取值：

1：待审批。

2：已审批。
不传时默认取值为1，只查询待审批状态的审批单。本参数仅支持V3.2.55及以上版本使用
parameters.name: approval_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the command approval request
parameters.help_zh:
命令审批单ID。
本参数仅支持V3.2.55及以上版本使用
parameters.name: approve_command_id

The status of the approval request. Valid values:

2: Approved
ApprovalStatus.description_zh:

ApprovalStatus.title_zh: 审批状态 1 待审批。2 已处理

ApproveCommandId.description_en: The ID of the command pending approval
